questions.question: The term used for the area over which a government or institution has legal authority, defined by geographical boundaries or by particular subjects, is:
options: Sovereign immunity
Diplomatic protocol
Jurisdiction
Veto prerogative
questions.explanation: Jurisdiction is the area over which someone has legal authority. It may be defined by geographical boundaries or by particular subjects. In a federal system, the Constitution specifies the jurisdiction of different levels of government.

questions.question: In 'Holding Together' federations like India, constituent states:
options: Always possess identical identical constitutional authority and independent militaries
Can secede unilaterally from the union at any moment
Very often do not have equal powers; some units are granted special powers or asymmetrical status
Have zero control over their state police departments
questions.explanation: In “holding together” federations such as India, the Central Government tends to be more powerful vis-à-vis the States. Constituent units may have unequal powers, and some units may receive special powers.

questions.question: According to the Indian Constitution, the official policy of promoting Hindi as an official language:
options: Mandates that all citizens must pass a compulsory Hindi speaking exam
Allows the Centre to dismiss any non-Hindi speaking Chief Minister
Prohibits state civil services from using regional languages
Does not mean that the Central Government can impose Hindi on States where people speak a different language
questions.explanation: Hindi is the official language of the Union, but the Constitution does not declare any language to be India’s national language. The Union’s policy promotes Hindi; this does not authorise the Union to impose it on States where people speak other languages. English continues to be used for official purposes alongside Hindi under the applicable law.

The nature of democratic politics, respect for diversity, and shared desire for living together
The price of crude oil in international markets
The total number of national holidays declared each year
